name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx for three SSL-enabled sites with virtual hosts, static content, redirects, security headers, TLS settings, logging, and host-level hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis, configures Redis logging, authentication, and service settings, and applies a post-configuration workaround for selected replication directives.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs the Python and PostgreSQL runtime for a FastAPI application, deploys the application, provisions its database and credentials, and runs it as a systemd service on port 8000.
